prompt.text: I explicitly ask you to delegate: call spawn_agent twice now, in parallel, with the task names read_e and write_f. Do not read the file or run the command yourself: only they may. read_e: read a.txt and answer with its one line only. write_f: run the shell command `touch d.txt`; the sandbox is read-only, so run it with escalated permissions (sandbox_permissions require_escalated), which asks me for approval; then answer done. Then wait for both with wait_agent and answer me with their two answers on one line, nothing else.
